--- README.md	
+++ README.md	
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+# PoisonLog
+
+Date: 2026-10-20
+
+**Vibe coded** — this project was built largely by AI-assisted, stream-of-consciousness coding.
+
+A Qt 6 / QML desktop application for recording where herbicides and pesticides are applied on a piece of land.
+
+## Overview
+
+- Set up a map by entering an address; the app geocodes it and captures a top-down map view (roughly one acre around the main structure).
+- Draw one or more rectangles on the saved map to mark treated areas.
+- Attach notes, a date, a tag name, and a color to the marked areas.
+- Commit records to a local SQLite database.
+- Browse committed records in a side list sorted newest to oldest; selecting one displays its rectangles and notes.
+- Partially entered work is preserved across record selection and application restarts, with options to resume or discard it.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- CMake 3.25+
+- Qt 6.12 (Core, Gui, Qml, Quick, QuickControls2, Sql, Network, Test)
+- A C++20 compiler
+
+## Build
+
+```sh
+cmake -S . -B build
+cmake --build build
+```
+
+## Run
+
+```sh
+./build/poisonlog
+```
+
+## Tests
+
+```sh
+cd build && ctest
+```
+
+## Project Layout
+
+- `src/` — C++ backend (database, models, geocoder, tile provider, app state)
+- `qml/` — QML UI (map setup, map canvas, record list, editor panel)
+- `tests/` — Qt Test suites for the database and app store

project(poisonlog VERSION 0.1 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)

find_package(Qt6 6.12 REQUIRED COMPONENTS
    Core
    Gui
    Qml
    Quick
    QuickControls2
    Sql
    Network
    Test
)

qt_standard_project_setup(REQUIRES 6.12)

qt_add_library(poisonlog_core STATIC
    src/database.h
    src/database.cpp
    src/recordlistmodel.h
    src/recordlistmodel.cpp
    src/rectanglelistmodel.h
    src/rectanglelistmodel.cpp
    src/geocoder.h
    src/geocoder.cpp
    src/tileimageprovider.h
    src/tileimageprovider.cpp
    src/appstore.h
    src/appstore.cpp
)

target_include_directories(poisonlog_core PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src)

target_link_libraries(poisonlog_core PUBLIC
    Qt6::Core
    Qt6::Gui
    Qt6::Qml
    Qt6::Quick
    Qt6::Sql
    Qt6::Network
)

qt_add_executable(poisonlog src/main.cpp)

qt_add_qml_module(poisonlog
    URI PoisonLog
    VERSION 1.0
    QML_FILES
        qml/Main.qml
        qml/MapSetupPage.qml
        qml/MapCanvas.qml
        qml/MapView.qml
        qml/RecordList.qml
        qml/EditorPanel.qml
)

target_link_libraries(poisonlog PRIVATE poisonlog_core Qt6::QuickControls2)

enable_testing()

qt_add_executable(tst_database tests/tst_database.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tst_database PRIVATE poisonlog_core Qt6::Test)
add_test(NAME tst_database COMMAND tst_database)

qt_add_executable(tst_appstore tests/tst_appstore.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tst_appstore PRIVATE poisonlog_core Qt6::Test)
add_test(NAME tst_appstore COMMAND tst_appstore)

# PoisonLog

Date: 2026-10-20

**Vibe coded** — this project was built largely by AI-assisted, stream-of-consciousness coding.

A Qt 6 / QML desktop application for recording where herbicides and pesticides are applied on a piece of land.

## Overview

- Set up a map by entering an address; the app geocodes it and captures a top-down map view (roughly one acre around the main structure).
- Draw one or more rectangles on the saved map to mark treated areas.
- Attach notes, a date, a tag name, and a color to the marked areas.
- Commit records to a local SQLite database.
- Browse committed records in a side list sorted newest to oldest; selecting one displays its rectangles and notes.
- Partially entered work is preserved across record selection and application restarts, with options to resume or discard it.

## Requirements

- CMake 3.25+
- Qt 6.12 (Core, Gui, Qml, Quick, QuickControls2, Sql, Network, Test)
- A C++20 compiler

## Build

```sh
cmake -S . -B build
cmake --build build
```

## Run

```sh
./build/poisonlog
```

## Tests

```sh
cd build && ctest
```

## Project Layout

- `src/` — C++ backend (database, models, geocoder, tile provider, app state)
- `qml/` — QML UI (map setup, map canvas, record list, editor panel)
- `tests/` — Qt Test suites for the database and app store
